RECORDS.description_main:
TP-Link Omada ER605 DHCPv6 Client Options Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Omada ER605 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of DHCP options. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-22420.
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link Omada ER605 DHCPv6 Client Options Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Omada ER605 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.\n\nThe specific flaw exists within the handling of DHCP options. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-22420."}]}

RECORDS.description_main:
TP-Link Omada ER605 Access Control Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Omada ER605. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific issue exists within the handling of the name field in the access control user interface. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-22227.

RECORDS.description_main:
TP-Link Omada ER605 PPTP VPN username Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Omada ER605 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. However, devices are only vulnerable if configured to use a PPTP VPN with LDAP authentication.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of the username parameter provided to the /usr/bin/pppd endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-22446.

RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR940N 3.20.1 Build 200316 Rel.34392n (5553) routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper access control. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. Was ZDI-CAN-13911.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞可以使网络邻近的攻击者在受影响的TP-Link TL-WR940N 3.20.1 Build 200316 Rel.34392n (5553)路由器上泄露敏感信息。 没有身份验证即可利用此漏洞。特定缺陷存在于默认情况下侦听TCP端口80的httpd服务中。 问题源于缺乏适当的访问控制。 攻击者可以利用此漏洞来披露存储的凭据，从而导致进一步的妥协。漏洞编号为ZDI-CAN-13911。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR940N 3.20.1 Build 200316 Rel.34392n (5553) routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper access control. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. Was ZDI-CAN-13911."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link TL-WR940N 3.20.1路由器存在任意代码执行漏洞
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link 已经在最新版本的固件中修复了该漏洞。强烈建议用户升级到最新版本并使用强密码来保护设备。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR940N 3.20.1 Build 200316 Rel.34392n (5553) routers. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-13992.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许附近的攻击者在受影响的TP-Link TL-WR940N 3.20.1 Build 200316 Rel.34392n（5553）路由器上执行任意代码。要利用此漏洞需要身份验证。该特定漏洞存在于httpd服务内，该服务默认在TCP端口80上侦听。该问题的原因在于在将用户提供的数据复制到基于固定长度堆栈的缓冲区之前，缺乏对用户提供数据长度的正确验证。攻击者可以利用此漏洞在root上下文中执行代码。漏洞编号为ZDI-CAN-13992。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR940N 3.20.1 Build 200316 Rel.34392n (5553) routers. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-13992."}]}

RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link Tapo C310 1.3.0设备存在安全漏洞，攻击者通过用户名和密码TPL075526460603可以访问RTSP视频流。

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link M7350 V3固件版本190531的Web配置界面存在预身份认证命令注入漏洞。
RECORDS.solution: 厂商已经发布了新的固件版本来修复此漏洞，请用户下载并安装最新的固件版本，同时应该注意保护自己的网络安全和隐私。
RECORDS.description_main: The web configuration interface of the TP-Link M7350 V3 with firmware version 190531 is affected by a pre-authentication command injection vulnerability.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 攻击者可以利用此漏洞在未经身份验证的情况下执行任意命令，从而导致敏感信息泄露或系统受到入侵。这可能会对用户的隐私和安全造成严重影响。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"The web configuration interface of the TP-Link M7350 V3 with firmware version 190531 is affected by a pre-authentication command injection vulnerability."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP Link Archer AX10 V1 固件版本 1.3.1 Build 20220401 Rel. 57450(5553) 发现可被认证攻击者通过造假备份文件执行任意代码
RECORDS.solution: TP Link 已经发布了修复补丁，请尽快更新设备固件。同时建议用户加强设备安全，确保只有授权的用户可以对设备进行操作。
RECORDS.description_main: TP Link Archer AX10 V1 Firmware Version 1.3.1 Build 20220401 Rel. 57450(5553) was discovered to allow authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted backup file.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP Link Archer AX10 V1 固件版本 1.3.1 Build 20220401 Rel. 57450(5553) 被发现存在可被认证的攻击者利用的漏洞。攻击者可以通过发送特制的备份文件来执行任意代码。这个漏洞可能会导致设备被完全接管或者敏感信息被泄露。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP Link Archer AX10 V1 Firmware Version 1.3.1 Build 20220401 Rel. 57450(5553) was discovered to allow authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted backup file."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: Tenda AC1900 AP500(US)_V1_180320(Beta)存在缓冲区溢出漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 厂商已经发布了更新版本，请及时下载并升级到最新版以避免安全风险。
RECORDS.description_main: Tenda AC1900 AP500(US)_V1_180320(Beta) was discovered to contain a buffer overflow in the 0x32384 function. This vulnerability allows attackers to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) via a crafted request.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在Tenda AC1900 AP500(US)_V1_180320(Beta)中发现0x32384函数存在缓冲区溢出漏洞。攻击者可以通过精心构造的请求造成拒绝服务攻击（DoS）。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Tenda AC1900 AP500(US)_V1_180320(Beta) was discovered to contain a buffer overflow in the 0x32384 function. This vulnerability allows attackers to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) via a crafted request."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link Tapo C200 V1 存在访问控制问题，攻击者通过连接 UART 针脚可获取 root 权限
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link 已经发布了更新，修复了这个漏洞。用户可以前往 TP-Link 官网下载最新的固件，并更新其设备以确保安全。
RECORDS.description_main: An access control issue on TP-LInk Tapo C200 V1 devices allows physically proximate attackers to obtain root access by connecting to the UART pins, interrupting the boot process, and setting an init=/bin/sh value.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link Tapo C200 V1 设备存在访问控制问题，攻击者只需连接 UART 针脚并中断启动过程，即可设置 init=/bin/sh 值获取 root 权限。这意味着攻击者可以访问设备并控制其功能，而不需要任何认证。这个问题会影响所有未升级到最新固件版本的设备。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"An access control issue on TP-LInk Tapo C200 V1 devices allows physically proximate attackers to obtain root access by connecting to the UART pins, interrupting the boot process, and setting an init=/bin/sh value."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link AX10v1 V1_211117网络应用客户端使用硬编码的加密密钥，存在安全漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 升级硬件和软件版本，使用随机密钥生成算法加密通信，避免硬编码密钥的使用。
RECORDS.description_main: The web app client of TP-Link AX10v1 V1_211117 uses hard-coded cryptographic keys when communicating with the router. Attackers who are able to intercept the communications between the web client and router through a man-in-the-middle attack can then obtain the sequence key via a brute-force attack, and access sensitive information.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link AX10v1 V1_211117的网络应用客户端在与路由器通信时使用硬编码的加密密钥。攻击者可以通过中间人攻击截获客户端和路由器之间的通信，再通过暴力破解获取序列密钥，并访问敏感信息。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"The web app client of TP-Link AX10v1 V1_211117 uses hard-coded cryptographic keys when communicating with the router. Attackers who are able to intercept the communications between the web client and router through a man-in-the-middle attack can then obtain the sequence key via a brute-force attack, and access sensitive information."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link AX10v1 V1_211117存在重放攻击漏洞
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link建议用户立即更新到最新的固件版本，并采取其他安全措施，如网站访问控制列表和强密码策略等。
RECORDS.description_main: TP-Link AX10v1 V1_211117 allows attackers to execute a replay attack by using a previously transmitted encrypted authentication message and valid authentication token. Attackers are able to login to the web application as an admin user.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 攻击者可以使用之前传输的加密身份验证消息和有效身份验证令牌执行重放攻击，从而能够以管理员用户身份登录到 Web 应用程序。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link AX10v1 V1_211117 allows attackers to execute a replay attack by using a previously transmitted encrypted authentication message and valid authentication token. Attackers are able to login to the web application as an admin user."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link RE300 V1的tdpServer未正确处理输入，可能导致攻击者利用产品的OneMesh功能造成拒绝服务（DoS）情况。
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link已经发布了更新，以修复此漏洞。用户应通过更新他们的RE300 V1设备的固件，以确保修复此漏洞并保持其设备的安全。
RECORDS.description_main: tdpServer of TP-Link RE300 V1 improperly processes its input, which may allow an attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) condition of the product's OneMesh function.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link RE300 V1的tdpServer未正确处理其输入。攻击者可以利用此漏洞，在不正确的数据中注入恶意代码，导致一系列问题，包括拒绝服务攻击、强制退出等。如果攻击者使用此漏洞，他们可以利用产品的OneMesh功能来阻止用户的访问和数据传输。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"tdpServer of TP-Link RE300 V1 improperly processes its input, which may allow an attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) condition of the product's OneMesh function."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link TL-WR841N 8.0 4.17.16 Build 120201 Rel.54750n 存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 更新固件至最新版本，谨慎点击未知来源链接，勿在不安全的公共网络下访问敏感信息。
RECORDS.description_main: TP-Link TL-WR841N 8.0 4.17.16 Build 120201 Rel.54750n is vulnerable to Cross Site Scripting (XSS).
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link TL-WR841N 8.0 4.17.16 Build 120201 Rel.54750n 存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，攻击者可以利用该漏洞在受害者的浏览器中执行恶意脚本代码，从而实现盗取用户的敏感信息、篡改页面显示等攻击目的。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link TL-WR841N 8.0 4.17.16 Build 120201 Rel.54750n is vulnerable to Cross Site Scripting (XSS)."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link TL-WR841N路由器存在严重漏洞
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link已经发表了安全公告，并发布了新版本的固件来修复此漏洞。用户应该立即下载并安装最新版本的固件，以保护其设备。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR841N TL-WR841N(US)_V14_220121 routers. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the ated_tp service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-17356.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许邻近网络的攻击者在受影响的TP-Link TL-WR841N TL-WR841N(US)_V14_220121路由器上执行任意代码。虽然需要认证才能利用此漏洞，但现有的认证机制可以被绕过。具体的缺陷存在于ated_tp服务中。问题是由于在使用用户提供的字符串执行系统调用之前缺乏正确的验证而导致的。攻击者可以利用此漏洞在root的上下文中执行代码。对应的CVE编号为ZDI-CAN-17356。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR841N TL-WR841N(US)_V14_220121 routers. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the ated_tp service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-17356."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link TL-WR740N存在一个问题漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 供应商已经发布了固件更新来修复这个漏洞，建议用户尽快升级到最新版本。此外，建议用户设置强密码和开启网络安全性的保护措施。

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link TL-WR940N路由器存在敏感信息泄漏漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 该漏洞的修复方案是更新路由器固件版本或联系厂商获得补丁以解决漏洞问题。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR940N 6_211111 3.20.1(US) routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from the incorrect implementation of the authentication algorithm. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. Was ZDI-CAN-17332.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许网络邻近攻击者在受影响的TP-Link TL-WR940N 6_211111 3.20.1 (美国)路由器安装上披露敏感信息。此漏洞无需身份验证即可利用。具体缺陷存在于监听默认TCP端口80的httpd服务中，该问题源于身份验证算法的错误实现。攻击者可以利用此漏洞披露存储的凭据，从而导致进一步的威胁。漏洞编号为ZDI-CAN-17332。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR940N 6_211111 3.20.1(US) routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from the incorrect implementation of the authentication algorithm. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. Was ZDI-CAN-17332."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link TL-WR940N路由器认证绕过漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 推荐使用最新版本的固件来修复该漏洞。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR940N 6_211111 3.20.1(US) routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from the lack of sufficient randomness in the sequnce numbers used for session managment. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-18334.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许邻近网络攻击者绕过受影响的TP-Link TL-WR940N 6_211111 3.20.1(US)路由器上的认证。利用该漏洞不需要进行身份验证。具体的漏洞存在于监听TCP端口80的httpd服务中，该问题是由于会话管理中使用的序列号缺乏足够的随机性所致。攻击者可以利用该漏洞绕过系统上的认证。编号为ZDI-CAN-18334。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR940N 6_211111 3.20.1(US) routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from the lack of sufficient randomness in the sequnce numbers used for session managment. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-18334."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link路由器漏洞：基于HTTP Basic Authentication的堆栈溢出
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link已发布了修补程序。建议所有用户 更新到最新版本的固件。
RECORDS.description_main: In TP-Link routers, Archer C5 and WR710N-V1, running the latest available code, when receiving HTTP Basic Authentication the httpd service can be sent a crafted packet that causes a heap overflow. This can result in either a DoS (by crashing the httpd process) or an arbitrary code execution.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在运行最新可用代码的TP-Link路由器中，例如Archer C5和WR710N-V1，当收到HTTP基本认证时，可以发送一个特制的数据包给httpd服务，这可能导致堆栈溢出。这可能导致拒绝服务攻击（通过崩溃httpd进程）或任意代码执行。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"In TP-Link routers, Archer C5 and WR710N-V1, running the latest available code, when receiving HTTP Basic Authentication the httpd service can be sent a crafted packet that causes a heap overflow. This can result in either a DoS (by crashing the httpd process) or an arbitrary code execution."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link 路由器存在安全漏洞，可被侧信道攻击入侵
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link 公司已发布更新版本修复了该漏洞，用户应及时升级路由器软件。此外，建议用户设置强密码，并关闭经常不使用的端口，以减少安全风险。
RECORDS.description_main: TP-Link routers, Archer C5 and WR710N-V1, using the latest software, the strcmp function used for checking credentials in httpd, is susceptible to a side-channel attack. By measuring the response time of the httpd process, an attacker could guess each byte of the username and password.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link 路由器 Archer C5 和 WR710N-V1 最新版软件中的 httpd 对称函数存在漏洞，攻击者通过测量 httpd 进程的响应时间，可猜测出用户名和密码的每个字节。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link routers, Archer C5 and WR710N-V1, using the latest software, the strcmp function used for checking credentials in httpd, is susceptible to a side-channel attack. By measuring the response time of the httpd process, an attacker could guess each byte of the username and password."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link TL-WR940N V4 3.16.9及更早版本允许经过身份验证的攻击者在固件更新过程中上传精心制作的固件映像，从而造成拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link 已经发布了固件更新版本，用户应该及时更新固件以修复该漏洞。此外，建议用户使用安全密码以防止未经授权的设备访问路由器，并确保路由器不暴露在 Internet 上。
RECORDS.description_main: TP-Link TL-WR940N V4 3.16.9 and earlier allows authenticated attackers to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) via uploading a crafted firmware image during the firmware update process.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link TL-WR940N V4 3.16.9及更早版本存在漏洞，允许经过身份验证的攻击者在固件更新过程中上传精心制作的固件映像，导致设备无法正常工作，从而造成拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。攻击者需要在设备已被授权的情况下才能利用此漏洞。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link TL-WR940N V4 3.16.9 and earlier allows authenticated attackers to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) via uploading a crafted firmware image during the firmware update process."}]}

RECORDS.solution: 用户应立即更新至最新版本的固件，以防止此漏洞被攻击者利用。另外，建议对网络进行适当的安全配置和加强网络设备的管理，以提高设备安全性和防范网络攻击。

RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link TL-WR1043ND V1 3.13.15版本及以前的所有版本，存在认证攻击者能够通过上传制作的固件映像文件来执行任意代码或导致拒绝服务 (DoS) 的漏洞。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link TL-WR1043ND V1 3.13.15 and earlier allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a Denial of Service (DoS) via uploading a crafted firmware image during the firmware update process."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link TL-WR740N V1和V2 v3.12.4及之前版本允许经过身份验证的攻击者在固件更新过程中上传恶意固件映像以执行任意代码或导致拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link已经发布了针对此漏洞的新固件版本。建议用户尽快将受影响的设备升级到最新固件版本，以确保设备的安全性和稳定性。
RECORDS.description_main: TP-Link TL-WR740N V1 and V2 v3.12.4 and earlier allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a Denial of Service (DoS) via uploading a crafted firmware image during the firmware update process.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link TL-WR740N V1和V2 v3.12.4及之前版本的固件存在安全漏洞，攻击者在经过身份验证的情况下可以在固件更新过程中上传恶意固件映像，导致执行任意代码或导致拒绝服务攻击。可能会影响到设备的安全性和稳定性。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link TL-WR740N V1 and V2 v3.12.4 and earlier allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a Denial of Service (DoS) via uploading a crafted firmware image during the firmware update process."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link TL-WR743ND V1存在可利用的固件修改漏洞

RECORDS.description_main: An exploitable firmware modification vulnerability was discovered on TP-Link TL-WR743ND V1. RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows a firewall bypass on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 prior to Archer C7(US)_V5_210125 and Archer A7(US)_V5_200220 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of IPv6 connections. The issue results from the lack of proper filtering of IPv6 SSH connections. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-12309.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许攻击者绕过TP-Link Archer A7 (US)_V5_210125和Archer A7 (US)_V5_200220 AC1750路由器上的防火墙。攻击者无需身份验证即可利用此漏洞。该问题具体存在于IPv6连接的处理中。问题的根源在于IPv6 SSH连接缺乏适当的过滤。攻击者可以结合其他漏洞来利用此问题以执行root上下文中的代码。该漏洞的CVE编号为ZDI-CAN-12309。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows a firewall bypass on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 prior to Archer C7(US)_V5_210125 and Archer A7(US)_V5_200220 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of IPv6 connections. The issue results from the lack of proper filtering of IPv6 SSH connections. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-12309."}]}

RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 AC1750 1.0.15 routers. A crafted TCP message can write stack pointers to the stack. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the root user. Was ZDI-CAN-12306."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: IPv6路由循环漏洞
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link已发布了固件更新，建议受影响的设备及时升级到最新版本。同时，建议网络管理员采取其他措施，如配置防火墙规则、关闭IPv6等，以减少攻击面。
RECORDS.description_main: In TP-Link TL-XDR3230 < 1.0.12, TL-XDR1850 < 1.0.9, TL-XDR1860 < 1.0.14, TL-XDR3250 < 1.0.2, TL-XDR6060 Turbo < 1.1.8, TL-XDR5430 < 1.0.11, and possibly others, when IPv6 is used, a routing loop can occur that generates excessive network traffic between an affected device and its upstream ISP's router. This occurs when a link prefix route points to a point-to-point link, a destination IPv6 address belongs to the prefix and is not a local IPv6 address, and a router advertisement is received with at least one global unique IPv6 prefix for which the on-link flag is set.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在TP-Link TL-XDR3230 < 1.0.12、TL-XDR1850 < 1.0.9、TL-XDR1860 < 1.0.14、TL-XDR3250 < 1.0.2、TL-XDR6060 Turbo < 1.1.8、TL-XDR5430 < 1.0.11以及其他可能存在漏洞的设备中，当使用IPv6时，可能发生路由循环问题，导致受影响设备与其上游ISP路由器之间的网络流量过大。这发生在链接前缀路由指向点对点链接时，目的IPv6地址属于该前缀而且不是本地IPv6地址，并且接收到至少一个全局唯一IPv6前缀的路由广告的情况下。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"In TP-Link TL-XDR3230 \u003c 1.0.12, TL-XDR1850 \u003c 1.0.9, TL-XDR1860 \u003c 1.0.14, TL-XDR3250 \u003c 1.0.2, TL-XDR6060 Turbo \u003c 1.1.8, TL-XDR5430 \u003c 1.0.11, and possibly others, when IPv6 is used, a routing loop can occur that generates excessive network traffic between an affected device and its upstream ISP's router. This occurs when a link prefix route points to a point-to-point link, a destination IPv6 address belongs to the prefix and is not a local IPv6 address, and a router advertisement is received with at least one global unique IPv6 prefix for which the on-link flag is set."}]}

RECORDS.description_main: TP-Link TL-SG2005, TL-SG2008, etc. 1.0.0 Build 20180529 Rel.40524 is affected by an Array index error. The interface that provides the "device description" function only judges the length of the received data, and does not filter special characters. This vulnerability will cause the application to crash, and all device configuration information will be erased.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞存在于 TP-Link TL-SG2005、 TL-SG2008 等版本中，版本号为 1.0.0 Build 20180529 Rel.40524。该设备描述功能接口只判断接收到的数据长度，不过滤特殊字符，导致该漏洞存在。该漏洞会导致应用程序崩溃，并且所有设备配置信息都将被擦除。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link TL-SG2005, TL-SG2008, etc. 1.0.0 Build 20180529 Rel.40524 is affected by an Array index error. The interface that provides the \"device description\" function only judges the length of the received data, and does not filter special characters. This vulnerability will cause the application to crash, and all device configuration information will be erased."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link UE330 USB splitter存在Glowworm攻击漏洞
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link已经发布了固件更新来修复这个漏洞，用户应及时更新他们的设备。此外，最好在将设备连接到任何网络之前，对其进行安全配置和设置。
RECORDS.description_main: TP-Link UE330 USB splitter devices through 2021-08-09, in certain specific use cases in which the device supplies power to audio-output equipment, allow remote attackers to recover speech signals from an LED on the device, via a telescope and an electro-optical sensor, aka a "Glowworm" attack. We assume that the USB splitter supplies power to some speakers. The power indicator LED of the USB splitter is connected directly to the power line, as a result, the intensity of the USB splitter's power indicator LED is correlative to its power consumption. The sound played by the connected speakers affects the USB splitter's power consumption and as a result is also correlative to the light intensity of the LED. By analyzing measurements obtained from an electro-optical sensor directed at the power indicator LED of the USB splitter, we can recover the sound played by the connected speakers.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在特定的使用情况下，TP-Link UE330 USB splitter设备通过2021-08-09，当设备向音频输出设备提供电源时，允许远程攻击者通过望远镜和电光传感器从设备上的LED恢复语音信号，也称为"Glowworm"攻击。我们假设USB分配器向某些扬声器供电。USB分配器的电源指示灯直接连接到电源线，因此，USB分配器的电源指示灯强度与其功耗成正相关。连接的扬声器播放的声音影响USB分配器的功耗，因此也与LED的光强度成正比。通过分析朝向USB分配器电源指示灯的电光传感器获得的测量数据，我们可以恢复连接扬声器播放的声音。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link UE330 USB splitter devices through 2021-08-09, in certain specific use cases in which the device supplies power to audio-output equipment, allow remote attackers to recover speech signals from an LED on the device, via a telescope and an electro-optical sensor, aka a \"Glowworm\" attack. We assume that the USB splitter supplies power to some speakers. The power indicator LED of the USB splitter is connected directly to the power line, as a result, the intensity of the USB splitter's power indicator LED is correlative to its power consumption. The sound played by the connected speakers affects the USB splitter's power consumption and as a result is also correlative to the light intensity of the LED. By analyzing measurements obtained from an electro-optical sensor directed at the power indicator LED of the USB splitter, we can recover the sound played by the connected speakers."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link、Edimax、NETGEAR、TP-Link、Tenda 和 Western Digital 设备存在整数溢出漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 厂商已经发布了针对此漏洞的补丁，建议及时更新固件以保证设备的安全性。
RECORDS.description_main: Certain D-Link, Edimax, NETGEAR, TP-Link, Tenda, and Western Digital devices are affected by an integer overflow by an unauthenticated attacker. Remote code execution from the WAN interface (TCP port 20005) cannot be ruled out; however, exploitability was judged to be of "rather significant complexity" but not "impossible." The overflow is in SoftwareBus_dispatchNormalEPMsgOut in the KCodes NetUSB kernel module. Affected NETGEAR devices are D7800 before 1.0.1.68, R6400v2 before 1.0.4.122, and R6700v3 before 1.0.4.122.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 未经身份验证的攻击者可利用整数溢出漏洞影响上述厂商的设备，存在远程代码执行风险（通过 WAN 接口的 TCP 端口 20005）。但是，攻击复杂度较高，且未被认为是不可能被攻击的。该漏洞出现在 KCodes NetUSB 内核模块的 SoftwareBus_dispatchNormalEPMsgOut 中。另外，NETGEAR 的 D7800（1.0.1.68 以前）、R6400v2（1.0.4.122 以前）和 R6700v3（1.0.4.122 以前）也会受到影响。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Certain D-Link, Edimax, NETGEAR, TP-Link, Tenda, and Western Digital devices are affected by an integer overflow by an unauthenticated attacker. Remote code execution from the WAN interface (TCP port 20005) cannot be ruled out; however, exploitability was judged to be of \"rather significant complexity\" but not \"impossible.\" The overflow is in SoftwareBus_dispatchNormalEPMsgOut in the KCodes NetUSB kernel module. Affected NETGEAR devices are D7800 before 1.0.1.68, R6400v2 before 1.0.4.122, and R6700v3 before 1.0.4.122."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link Archer A7路由器固件漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 尽快升级固件至最新版本。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of DNS responses. A crafted DNS message can trigger an overflow of a fixed-length, stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the root user. Was ZDI-CAN-9660.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许远程攻击者在受影响的TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver：190726 AC1750路由器上执行任意代码。认证不需要利用此漏洞。具体缺陷存在于DNS响应处理中。精心制作的DNS消息可以触发固定长度的基于堆栈的缓冲区溢出。攻击者可以利用此漏洞在root用户上下文中执行代码。修补解决方案: 尽快升级固件至最新版本。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of DNS responses. A crafted DNS message can trigger an overflow of a fixed-length, stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the root user. Was ZDI-CAN-9660."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 路由器存在代码执行漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 厂商尚未发布此漏洞的修复方案，请及时更新固件以提高网络安全性。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the tdpServer service, which listens on UDP port 20002 by default. When parsing the slave_mac parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the root user. Was ZDI-CAN-9650.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 此漏洞允许网络附近的攻击者在受影响的 TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 路由器上执行任意代码。不需要进行身份验证即可利用此漏洞。具体漏洞存在于 tdpServer 服务中，默认监听 UDP 端口20002。在解析 slave_mac 参数时，进程在使用用户提供的字符串之前并未正确验证。攻击者可以利用此漏洞以 root 用户身份执行代码。修复方案尚未公布。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the tdpServer service, which listens on UDP port 20002 by default. When parsing the slave_mac parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the root user. Was ZDI-CAN-9650."}]}

RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 routers. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the file system. The issue lies in the lack of proper permissions set on the file system. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges. Was ZDI-CAN-9651.

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link Archer A7 AC1750路由器存在漏洞
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link推出了固件升级版本来修复此漏洞问题。建议所有受影响的用户立即升级到最新版本，以确保安全性。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the tdpServer service, which listens on UDP port 20002 by default. This issue results from the use of hard-coded encryption key. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-9652.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 此漏洞允许网络邻近的攻击者在受影响的TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750路由器上执行任意代码。不需要验证即可利用此漏洞。具体错误存在于tdpServer服务中，该服务默认监听UDP端口20002。此问题源于使用硬编码的加密密钥。攻击者可以与其他漏洞结合使用，以root的上下文中执行代码。漏洞编号为ZDI-CAN-9652。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the tdpServer service, which listens on UDP port 20002 by default. This issue results from the use of hard-coded encryption key. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-9652."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link Archer A7 固件漏洞
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link 建议受影响用户立即更新路由器的固件版本，以修复该漏洞。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of DNS responses. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of DNS reponses prior to further processing. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of the root user. Was ZDI-CAN-9661.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许远程攻击者在受影响的 TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 路由器上执行任意代码。攻击者不需要进行身份验证即可利用此漏洞。具体漏洞存在于 DNS 响应的处理中，因缺乏适当的验证，导致出现问题。攻击者可以利用此漏洞和其他漏洞一起，以 root 用户的上下文中执行代码。漏洞编号为 ZDI-CAN-9661。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of DNS responses. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of DNS reponses prior to further processing. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of the root user. Was ZDI-CAN-9661."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 路由器存在远程代码执行漏洞
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link 已经发布了固件更新来修复此漏洞。用户应该立即更新固件以及将服务绑定到仅受信任的 IP 地址上。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the tmpServer service, which listens on TCP port 20002. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-9662.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许远程攻击者在受影响的 TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 路由器上执行任意代码。攻击者无需进行身份验证即可利用此漏洞。具体漏洞存在于 tmpServer 服务中，该服务监听 TCP 端口 20002。问题在于在使用用户提供的字符串执行系统调用之前，缺乏对其进行适当的验证。攻击者可以利用此漏洞在当前进程的上下文中执行代码。漏洞编号为 ZDI-CAN-9662。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the tmpServer service, which listens on TCP port 20002. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-9662."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link Archer A7 路由器固件漏洞可绕过防火墙
RECORDS.solution: 厂商已发布新版本固件对此漏洞进行修复。用户需及时更新其路由器固件版本，以提升安全性。同时也建议用户对路由器配置进行适当的加固，如开启身份验证等。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows a firewall bypass on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of IPv6 connections. The issue results from the lack of proper filtering of IPv6 SSH connections. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-9663.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 此漏洞允许攻击者在受影响的 TP-Link Archer A7 固件版本为190726的 AC1750 路由器上绕过防火墙，无需身份验证即可利用。此问题存在于 IPv6 连接处理中的缺陷。问题的根源在于 IPv6 SSH 连接的过滤不够严格。攻击者可以结合其他漏洞利用此问题，在 root 上下文中执行代码。漏洞编号是 ZDI-CAN-9663。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows a firewall bypass on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of IPv6 connections. The issue results from the lack of proper filtering of IPv6 SSH connections. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-9663."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link Archer A7 路由器固件漏洞导致身份验证绕过
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link 已发布了修复此漏洞的软件更新。建议用户立即升级到固件版本为 190930 或更高版本，以避免遭受攻击。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of SSH port forwarding requests during initial setup. The issue results from the lack of proper authentication prior to establishing SSH port forwarding rules. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges to resources normally protected from the WAN interface. Was ZDI-CAN-9664.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许远程攻击者绕过身份验证，攻击影响范围为 TP-Link Archer A7 固件版本为 190726 AC1750 的路由器，攻击者无需进行身份验证即可利用该漏洞。此特定漏洞存在于 SSH 端口转发请求的处理过程中。该问题由于在建立 SSH 端口转发规则之前缺乏适当的身份验证而导致。攻击者可以利用此漏洞将特权提升到通常受到 WAN 接口保护的资源。ZDI-CAN-9664。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 Firmware Ver: 190726 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of SSH port forwarding requests during initial setup. The issue results from the lack of proper authentication prior to establishing SSH port forwarding rules. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges to resources normally protected from the WAN interface. Was ZDI-CAN-9664."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link TL-WA855RE固件Ver：855rev4-up-ver1-0-1-P1[20191213-rel60361] Wi-Fi扩展器的特权升级漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 修复方案包括更新到最新固件版本，以确保安全补丁得到应用。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WA855RE Firmware Ver: 855rev4-up-ver1-0-1-P1[20191213-rel60361] Wi-Fi extenders. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the first-time setup process. The issue results from the lack of proper validation on first-time setup requests. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to reset the password for the Admin account and execute code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-10003.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 这个漏洞允许网络相邻的攻击者在受影响的 TP-Link TL-WA855RE 固件 Ver：855rev4-up-ver1-0-1-P1[20191213-rel60361] Wi-Fi 扩展器上升级权限。虽然需要认证才能利用此漏洞，但现有的认证机制可以被绕过。具体缺陷存在于首次设置过程中。此问题的原因是在首次设置请求中缺少适当的验证。攻击者可以利用此漏洞重置管理员帐户的密码并在设备的上下文中执行代码。漏洞编号为 ZDI-CAN-10003。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WA855RE Firmware Ver: 855rev4-up-ver1-0-1-P1[20191213-rel60361] Wi-Fi extenders. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the first-time setup process. The issue results from the lack of proper validation on first-time setup requests. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to reset the password for the Admin account and execute code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-10003."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link云摄像头通过2020-02-09允许远程攻击者通过启用GPS的Wi-Fi会话绕过身份验证并获取敏感信息，又名CNVD-2020-04855。
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link已经确认了这个问题，并提供了以下修复程序： 1.升级固件。 2.禁用Wi-Fi会话GPS。
RECORDS.description_main: TP-Link cloud cameras through 2020-02-09 allow remote attackers to bypass authentication and obtain sensitive information via vectors involving a Wi-Fi session with GPS enabled, aka CNVD-2020-04855.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 此漏洞可使攻击者通过允许启用GPS的Wi-Fi会话绕过身份验证，从而获取敏感信息。攻击者可以获取未经授权的访问权限并窃取信息。漏洞影响云摄像头。但是，攻击者只能利用该漏洞与设备处于同一Wi-Fi网络中。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link cloud cameras through 2020-02-09 allow remote attackers to bypass authentication and obtain sensitive information via vectors involving a Wi-Fi session with GPS enabled, aka CNVD-2020-04855."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: The Open Connectivity Foundation UPnP specification before 2020-04-17 does not forbid the acceptance of a subscription request with a delivery URL on a different network segment than the fully qualified event-subscription URL, aka the CallStranger issue.
RECORDS.solution: 更新UPnP规范以禁止接受发送到不同网络段的投递URL的订阅请求。
RECORDS.description_main: The Open Connectivity Foundation UPnP specification before 2020-04-17 does not forbid the acceptance of a subscription request with a delivery URL on a different network segment than the fully qualified event-subscription URL, aka the CallStranger issue.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在2020年4月17日之前，开放互联互通基金会UPnP规范未禁止接受发送到不同网络段的投递URL的订阅请求，而完全合格的事件订阅URL，也就是CallStranger问题。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"The Open Connectivity Foundation UPnP specification before 2020-04-17 does not forbid the acceptance of a subscription request with a delivery URL on a different network segment than the fully qualified event-subscription URL, aka the CallStranger issue."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-LINK NC系列监控设备存在缓冲区溢出漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 建议尽快升级设备固件版本或采取其他安全措施，TP-LINK已经发布补丁修补该漏洞。
RECORDS.description_main: TP-LINK NC200 devices through 2.1.10 build 200401, NC210 devices through 1.0.10 build 200401, NC220 devices through 1.3.1 build 200401, NC230 devices through 1.3.1 build 200401, NC250 devices through 1.3.1 build 200401, NC260 devices through 1.5.3 build_200401, and NC450 devices through 1.5.4 build 200401 have a Buffer Overflow
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-LINK NC200设备通过2.1.10 build 200401、NC210设备通过1.0.10 build 200401、NC220设备通过1.3.1 build 200401、NC230设备通过1.3.1 build 200401、NC250设备通过1.3.1 build 200401、NC260设备通过1.5.3 build_200401和NC450设备通过1.5.4 build 200401存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，攻击者可以通过精心构造的请求利用该漏洞执行任意代码或导致拒绝服务攻击。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-LINK NC200 devices through 2.1.10 build 200401, NC210 devices through 1.0.10 build 200401, NC220 devices through 1.3.1 build 200401, NC230 devices through 1.3.1 build 200401, NC250 devices through 1.3.1 build 200401, NC260 devices through 1.5.3 build_200401, and NC450 devices through 1.5.4 build 200401 have a Buffer Overflow"}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link TL-WR740N v4和TL-WR740ND v4设备存在安全漏洞
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link已经发布了更新的固件版本。用户应该立即更新他们的设备以防止该漏洞被利用。
RECORDS.description_main: On TP-Link TL-WR740N v4 and TL-WR740ND v4 devices, an attacker with access to the admin panel can inject HTML code and change the HTML context of the target pages and stations in the access-control settings via targets_lists_name or hosts_lists_name. The vulnerability can also be exploited through a CSRF, requiring no authentication as an administrator.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 攻击者在访问管理面板时，可以通过targets_lists_name或hosts_lists_name注入HTML代码并更改目标页面和访问控制设置中的HTML文本。漏洞也可以通过CSRF攻击利用，无需身份验证作为管理员。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"On TP-Link TL-WR740N v4 and TL-WR740ND v4 devices, an attacker with access to the admin panel can inject HTML code and change the HTML context of the target pages and stations in the access-control settings via targets_lists_name or hosts_lists_name. The vulnerability can also be exploited through a CSRF, requiring no authentication as an administrator."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link USB Network Server TL-PS310U设备2.079.000.t0210版本之前存在漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 建议升级设备到最新版本，或者禁用远程管理功能，使用局域网内部能访问该设备的主机进行管理操作。此外，建议开启设备的加密传输功能，遵循网络安全最佳实践。
RECORDS.description_main: TP-Link USB Network Server TL-PS310U devices before 2.079.000.t0210 allow an attacker on the same network to elevate privileges because the administrative password can be discovered by sniffing unencrypted UDP traffic.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在同一网络中，攻击者可以通过嗅探未加密的UDP流量发现管理员密码，从而提升特权。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link USB Network Server TL-PS310U devices before 2.079.000.t0210 allow an attacker on the same network to elevate privileges because the administrative password can be discovered by sniffing unencrypted UDP traffic."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link USB网络服务器TL-PS310U低于2.079.000.t0210版本设备存在认证绕过漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 建议用户尽快升级至最新版本。
RECORDS.description_main: TP-Link USB Network Server TL-PS310U devices before 2.079.000.t0210 allow an attacker on the same network to bypass authentication via a web-administration request that lacks a password parameter.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link USB网络服务器TL-PS310U低于2.079.000.t0210版本的设备存在认证绕过漏洞。同一网络中的攻击者可以通过一个缺少密码参数的Web管理请求来绕过认证。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link USB Network Server TL-PS310U devices before 2.079.000.t0210 allow an attacker on the same network to bypass authentication via a web-administration request that lacks a password parameter."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link USB Network Server TL-PS310U存在XSS漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 更新设备固件版本至2.079.000.t0210或以上。
RECORDS.description_main: TP-Link USB Network Server TL-PS310U devices before 2.079.000.t0210 allow an attacker on the same network to conduct persistent XSS attacks by leveraging administrative privileges to set a crafted server name.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link USB Network Server TL-PS310U设备在2.079.000.t0210版本之前存在漏洞，攻击者可以通过利用管理权限设置精心制作的服务器名称，从而在相同网络上进行持续的XSS攻击。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link USB Network Server TL-PS310U devices before 2.079.000.t0210 allow an attacker on the same network to conduct persistent XSS attacks by leveraging administrative privileges to set a crafted server name."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link USB Network Server TL-PS310U存在漏洞
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link已经发布了修补程序来修复该漏洞。建议用户尽快更新其设备到最新版本，以确保网络安全性。
RECORDS.description_main: TP-Link USB Network Server TL-PS310U devices before 2.079.000.t0210 allow an attacker on the same network to denial-of-service the device via long input values.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link USB Network Server TL-PS310U设备在版本2.079.000.t0210及之前的版本中存在漏洞，攻击者可以在同一网络中通过长输入值来拒绝服务攻击该设备。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link USB Network Server TL-PS310U devices before 2.079.000.t0210 allow an attacker on the same network to denial-of-service the device via long input values."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link Archer C1200固件版本1.13 Build 2018/01/24 rel.52299 EU存在XSS漏洞，允许远程攻击者执行任意代码。
RECORDS.solution: 厂商已经发布修复版本，请用户及时升级至最新版本，并避免使用不信任的网络或下载未知的程序。
RECORDS.description_main: TP-Link Archer C1200 firmware version 1.13 Build 2018/01/24 rel.52299 EU has a XSS vulnerability allowing a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link Archer C1200固件版本1.13 Build 2018/01/24 rel.52299 EU存在XSS漏洞，远程攻击者可以通过特别设计的网络请求在受影响设备上进行代码注入和执行，从而获取系统控制权或执行其他恶意操作。此漏洞可能会对用户的网络和数据造成严重威胁。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link Archer C1200 firmware version 1.13 Build 2018/01/24 rel.52299 EU has a XSS vulnerability allowing a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link TL-WPA4220 设备上的 httpd 存在安全漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 更新固件版本至 TL-WPA4220(EU)_V4_201023。
RECORDS.description_main: httpd on TP-Link TL-WPA4220 devices (versions 2 through 4) allows remote authenticated users to execute arbitrary OS commands by sending crafted POST requests to the endpoint /admin/powerline. Fixed version: TL-WPA4220(EU)_V4_201023
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link TL-WPA4220 设备上的 httpd (版本从 2 到 4) 存在安全漏洞。远程验证用户通过向端点 /admin/powerline 发送特制的 POST 请求，可以执行任意的操作系统命令。修复方案为更新固件版本至 TL-WPA4220(EU)_V4_201023。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"httpd on TP-Link TL-WPA4220 devices (versions 2 through 4) allows remote authenticated users to execute arbitrary OS commands by sending crafted POST requests to the endpoint /admin/powerline. Fixed version: TL-WPA4220(EU)_V4_201023"}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link TL-WA855RE V5允许未经身份验证的攻击者发起工厂复位和重启请求
RECORDS.solution: 建议用户升级TP-Link TL-WA855RE V5设备的固件版本，以修复此漏洞。另外，网络管理员还应该采取其他措施来保护网络安全，例如设置强密码和网络防火墙等。
RECORDS.description_main: TP-Link TL-WA855RE V5 20200415-rel37464 devices allow an unauthenticated attacker (on the same network) to submit a TDDP_RESET POST request for a factory reset and reboot. The attacker can then obtain incorrect access control by setting a new administrative password.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link TL-WA855RE V5 20200415-rel37464设备允许未经身份验证的攻击者（在相同网络上）提交TDDP_RESET POST请求进行工厂复位和重启。攻击者可以通过设置新的管理员密码获得错误的访问控制。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link TL-WA855RE V5 20200415-rel37464 devices allow an unauthenticated attacker (on the same network) to submit a TDDP_RESET POST request for a factory reset and reboot. The attacker can then obtain incorrect access control by setting a new administrative password."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link TL-WPA4220设备上的httpd存在漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 安装修复版本: TL-WPA4220(EU)_V4_201023。
RECORDS.description_main: httpd on TP-Link TL-WPA4220 devices (hardware versions 2 through 4) allows remote authenticated users to trigger a buffer overflow (causing a denial of service) by sending a POST request to the /admin/syslog endpoint. Fixed version: TL-WPA4220(EU)_V4_201023
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link TL-WPA4220设备上的httpd（硬件版本2到4）存在漏洞，允许远程认证用户通过向/admin/syslog端点发送POST请求触发缓冲区溢出（导致拒绝服务）。修复版本: TL-WPA4220(EU)_V4_201023。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"httpd on TP-Link TL-WPA4220 devices (hardware versions 2 through 4) allows remote authenticated users to trigger a buffer overflow (causing a denial of service) by sending a POST request to the /admin/syslog endpoint. Fixed version: TL-WPA4220(EU)_V4_201023"}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link Archer A7 AC1750 设备的 tdpServer 在201029之前存在漏洞，允许远程攻击者通过 slave_mac 参数执行任意代码
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link 推出修复补丁，请及时更新设备！
RECORDS.description_main: tdpServer on TP-Link Archer A7 AC1750 devices before 201029 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via the slave_mac parameter. NOTE: this issue exists because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2020-10882 in which shell quotes are mishandled.

NOTE: this issue exists because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2020-10882 in which shell quotes are mishandled."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link TL-WR841N V13 (JP)固件中traceroute功能存在命令注入漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 升级到固件版本201216或更高版本。
RECORDS.description_main: A Command Injection issue in the traceroute feature on TP-Link TL-WR841N V13 (JP) with firmware versions prior to 201216 allows authenticated users to execute arbitrary code as root via shell metacharacters, a different vulnerability than CVE-2018-12577.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link TL-WR841N V13 (JP)固件版本小于201216的认证用户可以通过shell元字符执行任意代码，此处漏洞与CVE-2018-12577不同。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"A Command Injection issue in the traceroute feature on TP-Link TL-WR841N V13 (JP) with firmware versions prior to 201216 allows authenticated users to execute arbitrary code as root via shell metacharacters, a different vulnerability than CVE-2018-12577."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link TL-WR840N 6_EU_0.9.1_4.16 设备上的 oal_ipt_addBridgeIsolationRules 函数存在 OS 命令注入漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 修复该漏洞的最佳方法是更新固件。如果更新不可行，可通过强制输入并检查输入的字符串，以确保其中没有任何潜在的命令注入内容。
RECORDS.description_main: oal_ipt_addBridgeIsolationRules on TP-Link TL-WR840N 6_EU_0.9.1_4.16 devices allows OS command injection because a raw string entered from the web interface (an IP address field) is used directly for a call to the system library function (for iptables). NOTE: oal_ipt_addBridgeIsolationRules is not the only function that calls util_execSystem.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在 TP-Link TL-WR840N 6_EU_0.9.1_4.16 设备上，oal_ipt_addBridgeIsolationRules 函数存在 OS 命令注入漏洞。该漏洞是因为从 Web 界面输入的原始字符串（即 IP 地址字段）直接用于调用系统库函数，导致可注入 OS 命令。注意：oal_ipt_addBridgeIsolationRules 不是唯一调用 util_execSystem 函数的功能。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"oal_ipt_addBridgeIsolationRules on TP-Link TL-WR840N 6_EU_0.9.1_4.16 devices allows OS command injection because a raw string entered from the web interface (an IP address field) is used directly for a call to the system library function (for iptables). NOTE: oal_ipt_addBridgeIsolationRules is not the only function that calls util_execSystem."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link Archer A7(US)_V5_200721存在UNIX符号链接（Symlink）跟随漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 请更新固件以修复该漏洞。
RECORDS.description_main: UNIX Symbolic Link (Symlink) Following in TP-Link Archer A7(US)_V5_200721 allows an authenticated admin user, with physical access and network access, to execute arbitrary code after plugging a crafted USB drive into the router.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 经过验证的管理员用户只需具备物理访问权限和网络访问权限，就可以在将经过特定处理的U盘插入路由器后执行任意代码。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"UNIX Symbolic Link (Symlink) Following in TP-Link Archer A7(US)_V5_200721 allows an authenticated admin user, with physical access and network access, to execute arbitrary code after plugging a crafted USB drive into the router."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link Archer C9(US)_V1_180125 固件的 UNIX 符号链接（Symlink）跟随功能存在漏洞
RECORDS.solution: TP-Link 已经发布了修复该漏洞的固件更新。建议用户尽快升级到最新版本。
RECORDS.description_main: UNIX Symbolic Link (Symlink) Following in TP-Link Archer C9(US)_V1_180125 firmware allows an unauthenticated actor, with physical access and network access, to read sensitive files and write to a limited set of files after plugging a crafted USB drive into the router.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者在插入特制 USB 驱动器后，通过物理访问和网络访问读取敏感文件并写入一组有限的文件。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"UNIX Symbolic Link (Symlink) Following in TP-Link Archer C9(US)_V1_180125 firmware allows an unauthenticated actor, with physical access and network access, to read sensitive files and write to a limited set of files after plugging a crafted USB drive into the router."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link TL-WR841N V10固件版本3.16.9的httpd守护程序中的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许经过身份验证的远程攻击者通过GET请求执行任意代码，获取Wi-Fi网络配置页面。
RECORDS.solution: 厂商已经发布了该漏洞的修复补丁。建议用户及时升级到最新的固件版本。同时，建议用户维护良好的网络安全习惯，关闭不必要的端口和服务，以避免被攻击利用漏洞。
RECORDS.description_main: A buffer overflow in the httpd daemon on TP-Link TL-WR841N V10 (firmware version 3.16.9) devices allows an authenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a GET request to the page for the configuration of the Wi-Fi network.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link TL-WR841N V10固件版本3.16.9的httpd守护程序中，存在一种缓冲区溢出漏洞。通过向Wi-Fi网络配置页面发送GET请求，经过身份验证的远程攻击者可以利用该漏洞执行任意代码。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"A buffer overflow in the httpd daemon on TP-Link TL-WR841N V10 (firmware version 3.16.9) devices allows an authenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a GET request to the page for the configuration of the Wi-Fi network."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link Archer AX21 (AX1800) 固件存在命令注入漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 厂商已经发布了固件版本 1.1.4 Build 20230219，修复了这个漏洞，用户应尽快升级固件版本来解决问题。此外，建议用户关闭远程管理功能，以增强网络安全性。
RECORDS.description_main: TP-Link Archer AX21 (AX1800) firmware versions before 1.1.4 Build 20230219 contained a command injection vulnerability in the country form of the /cgi-bin/luci;stok=/locale endpoint on the web management interface. Specifically, the country parameter of the write operation was not sanitized before being used in a call to popen(), allowing an unauthenticated attacker to inject commands, which would be run as root, with a simple POST request.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link Archer AX21 (AX1800) 固件版本在 1.1.4 Build 20230219 之前存在命令注入漏洞，漏洞位于 Web 管理界面的 /cgi-bin/luci;stok=/locale 终端的国家表单。具体来说，写操作的国家参数在使用 popen() 调用之前没有进行净化，这使得未经身份验证的攻击者可以通过简单的 POST 请求注入命令，并以 root 权限运行。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link Archer AX21 (AX1800) firmware versions before 1.1.4 Build 20230219 contained a command injection vulnerability in the country form of the /cgi-bin/luci;stok=/locale endpoint on the web management interface. Specifically, the country parameter of the write operation was not sanitized before being used in a call to popen(), allowing an unauthenticated attacker to inject commands, which would be run as root, with a simple POST request."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link SG105PE固件存在认证绕过漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 请更新到最新版本' TL-SG105PE(UN) 1.0_1.0.0 Build 20221208 '以修复此漏洞。
RECORDS.description_main: TP-Link SG105PE firmware prior to 'TL-SG105PE(UN) 1.0_1.0.0 Build 20221208' contains an authentication bypass vulnerability. Under the certain conditions, an attacker may impersonate an administrator of the product. As a result, information may be obtained and/or the product's settings may be altered with the privilege of the administrator.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link SG105PE固件在' TL-SG105PE(UN) 1.0_1.0.0 Build 20221208 '之前的版本存在认证绕过漏洞。在特定条件下，攻击者可以冒充产品管理员，从而获取信息和/或以管理员的权限更改产品设置。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link SG105PE firmware prior to 'TL-SG105PE(UN) 1.0_1.0.0 Build 20221208' contains an authentication bypass vulnerability. Under the certain conditions, an attacker may impersonate an administrator of the product. As a result, information may be obtained and/or the product's settings may be altered with the privilege of the administrator."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-Link 路由器 TL-WR940N V6 3.19.1 Build 180119 使用已废弃的 MD5 算法进行基本认证管理员密码哈希
RECORDS.solution: 升级路由器固件或修改管理员密码，建议使用更安全的密码哈希算法例如 SHA-256 进行哈希密码。
RECORDS.description_main: TP-Link router TL-WR940N V6 3.19.1 Build 180119 uses a deprecated MD5 algorithm to hash the admin password used for basic authentication.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: TP-Link 路由器 TL-WR940N V6 3.19.1 Build 180119 在进行基本认证时对管理员密码使用已经被废弃的 MD5 算法进行哈希。这使得攻击者可能通过字典攻击或彩虹表攻击等方式获得管理员密码进而控制路由器。用户应该升级固件或改变管理员密码以保护自己的网络安全。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"TP-Link router TL-WR940N V6 3.19.1 Build 180119 uses a deprecated MD5 algorithm to hash the admin password used for basic authentication."}]}

RECORDS.description_main:
TP-Link Archer AX21 tdpServer Logging Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Archer AX21 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the logging functionality of the tdpServer program, which listens on UDP port 20002. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
. Was ZDI-CAN-19898.

TP-Link Archer AX21 tmpServer Command 0x422 Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Archer AX21 routers. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of command 0x422 provided to the tmpServer service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
. Was ZDI-CAN-19905.

TP-Link AX1800 Firmware Parsing Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link AX1800 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the parsing of firmware images. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
. Was ZDI-CAN-19703.

TP-Link AX1800 hotplugd Firewall Rule Race Condition Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to gain access to LAN-side services on affected installations of TP-Link Archer AX21 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the hotplugd daemon. The issue results from firewall rule handling that allows an attacker access to resources that should be available to the LAN interface only. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the root user.
. Was ZDI-CAN-19664.

RECORDS.description_main:
TP-Link Tapo C210 Password Recovery Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of TP-Link Tapo C210 IP cameras. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the password recovery mechanism. The issue results from reliance upon the secrecy of the password derivation algorithm when generating a recovery password. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
. Was ZDI-CAN-20484.

An attacker can make an authenticated HTTP request to trigger this vulnerability and gain access to an unrestricted shell."}]}

RECORDS.description_main:
TP-Link TL-WR841N ated_tp Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR841N routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the ated_tp service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-21825.

Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.\n\nThe specific flaw exists within the ated_tp service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-21825."}]}

RECORDS.description_main:
TP-Link Tapo C210 ActiveCells Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Tapo C210 IP cameras. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of the ActiveCells parameter of the CreateRules and ModifyRules APIs. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
. Was ZDI-CAN-20589.

RECORDS.title_zh: TP-LINK AC1350无线MU-MIMO千兆接入点Web界面Radio调度功能缓冲区溢出漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 更新到最新版本或应用厂商提供的补丁，以修复此漏洞。
RECORDS.description_main: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the web interface Radio Scheduling functionality of Tp-Link AC1350 Wireless MU-MIMO Gigabit Access Point (EAP225 V3) v5.1.0 Build 20220926. A specially crafted series of HTTP requests can lead to remote code execution. An attacker can make an authenticated HTTP request to trigger this vulnerability.This vulnerability refers specifically to the overflow that occurs via the `ssid` parameter at offset `0x0045ab7c` of the `httpd_portal` binary shipped with v5.1.0 Build 20220926 of the EAP225.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: Tp-Link AC1350无线MU-MIMO千兆接入点（EAP225 V3）v5.1.0 Build 20220926的Web界面Radio调度功能存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞。通过精心构造的一系列HTTP请求可能导致远程代码执行。攻击者可以通过发送认证的HTTP请求来触发此漏洞。该漏洞具体指通过ssid参数在httpd_portal二进制文件中的0x0045ab7c偏移处发生的溢出。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the web interface Radio Scheduling functionality of Tp-Link AC1350 Wireless MU-MIMO Gigabit Access Point (EAP225 V3) v5.1.0 Build 20220926. A specially crafted series of HTTP requests can lead to remote code execution. An attacker can make an authenticated HTTP request to trigger this vulnerability.This vulnerability refers specifically to the overflow that occurs via the `ssid` parameter at offset `0x0045ab7c` of the `httpd_portal` binary shipped with v5.1.0 Build 20220926 of the EAP225."}]}

RECORDS.description_main:
TP-Link TL-WR841N dropbearpwd Improper Authentication Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR841N routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from improper authentication. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise.
. Was ZDI-CAN-19899.

TP-Link TL-WR902AC dm_fillObjByStr Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR902AC routers. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the libcmm.so module. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
. Was ZDI-CAN-21819.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability in TP-Link TP-Link EX20v AX1800, Tp-Link Archer C5v AC1200, Tp-Link TD-W9970, Tp-Link TD-W9970v3, TP-Link VX220-G2u, TP-Link VN020-G2u allows authenticated OS Command Injection.This issue affects TP-Link EX20v AX1800, Tp-Link Archer C5v AC1200, Tp-Link TD-W9970, Tp-Link TD-W9970v3 : through 20240328. Also  the vulnerability continues in the TP-Link VX220-G2u and TP-Link VN020-G2u models due to the products not being produced and supported.
